scopeVerdict: Sequencing, cancellation/draining, rollback/save/input/follower ownership clean at reviewed bytes; F1 connected-map frame consumption is a confirmed correctness issue, F2 is a misleading priority comment. No approval of later fixes or audio wiring.

findings.trigger: Completed physical step crosses owner-map connection whose frame script condition matches and changes after execution.
findings.mechanism: enterMap runs checkFrameTriggers and discards consumed result; checkEvents resumes after entry and can advance daycare or later roll wild.
findings.preciseImpact: A ready Egg may hatch after the already consumed frame event. If no hatch consumes the step, a wild encounter may run. This does NOT mean a wild battle also runs after a consumed hatch.
findings.fix: Pass deferTriggers=true as seventh enterMap argument at the owner connection; existing frame-then-trainer check then consumes before daycare.
findings.status: Root reports two-line fix and regression fixture in progress; not automatically approved by original review.

findings.mechanism: Comment lists repel as a higher-priority handler before daycare, but field_control.c runs daycare before repel.
findings.fix: Keep forced movement/poison/Safari before daycare; describe repel after daycare and unported.
findings.status: Root reports comment corrected; fresh hash/test follow-up pending.
